>>     param(
>>         [string]$RelativePath,
>>         [string]$Base64Gzip
>>     )
>>
>>     $fullPath = Join-Path $ProjectPath $RelativePath
>>     $dir = Split-Path -Parent $fullPath
>>     if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) {
>>         New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null

>>     $compressedBytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($Base64Gzip)
>>     $inputStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(,$compressedBytes)
>>     $gzipStream = New-Object System.IO.Compression.GzipStream($inputStream, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
>>     $outputStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
>>     $gzipStream.CopyTo($outputStream)
>>     $gzipStream.Close()
>>     $bytes = $outputStream.ToArray()
>>
>>     [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($fullPath, $bytes)
>>     Write-Host "  wrote $RelativePath ($($bytes.Length) bytes)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
>> }

>> STEP 0 (do this before any new feature work, and treat it as its own

>> pgTAP coverage under supabase/tests, unit tests under tests/unit,

>> application code.
>>

>>
>> GAP 3: Employee and client photos.
>> Add nullable avatar_path columns to profiles and clients following the
>> exact private-storage pattern already used for
>> sections.reference_image_path and leaf_items.reference_image_path in

>> bucket, strict jpeg/png/webp MIME allowlist, file size limit, RLS-scoped

>> way the original storage migration is documented. Every place a client
>> or employee name renders anywhere in the admin UI must show their
>> avatar with an initials-based fallback when unset. Add upload/change
>> controls to the client form and to the employee detail page.
>>
>> GAP 4: Client detail page.
>> There is no /admin/clients/[clientId] route today, only a flat list at
>> src/app/[locale]/admin/clients/page.tsx. Add one, following the exact
>> same dynamic-route/guard/DTO pattern GAP 1 established for
>> /admin/staff/[employeeId]. Every client name anywhere in the admin UI
>> must link to it. This page must show in one place: client profile
>> fields and photo, the full section/sub-section tree for that client
>> with images at every depth, assigned employees current and historical,
>> that client's recent and upcoming schedule, recent daily plans and
>> completion stats, and any overdue mandatory tool-step escalations,
>> reusing the existing src/features/admin/reports read layer instead of
>> duplicating query logic. Every employee, section, and leaf item name
>> shown here must itself link to its own detail view per GAP 6.
>>
>> GAP 5: Properly designed unlimited nested sub-sections.
>> The section self-reference and cycle-prevention constraints in

>> src/components/ui primitives and Operational Clarity tokens so

>> applicable), and generous spacing on both desktop and mobile widths.
>>
>> GAP 6: Global click-through navigation and edit-from-anywhere.
>> Add one shared client component used everywhere a client, employee,
>> section, or leaf item name/avatar renders across the admin surface,
>> that always navigates to that entity's own detail location (GAP 1's
